_doc: The Drill State Read workflow's spec (D6c, 2026-10-27): its committed export is n8n/workflow.drill-state.sanitized.json, listed with its workflow id in scripts/check-exports-parity.sh's WORKFLOWS (read through scripts/workflows.py). The export is the reference for name, nodes, connections and settings; this file holds only what the export cannot: the settings a live workflow may carry beyond its export. The migration-era fields (original, nodes, trigger, temp_trigger) went with the copy↔original pairing.
